description_en: Queries the information about Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to which a website service is added
description_zh: 查询网站业务关联的DDoS高防实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-web-instance-relations --resource-group-id default --domains www.aliyun00.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeWebInstanceRelations

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain names of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain names. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名列表。

域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domains
